text:
lena (Finance): Heads up: TelosSec Ltd sent INV-2026-77 for 42,500 ILS. Invoice header says billing entity: TelosSec Ltd (IL) but has a note: 'if Israeli WHT applies, Redwood must gross-up'. Also attached a scanned Israeli tax card and a pdf labelled TRC_pending.pdf. Can we pay net?
mateo (AP): Hold payment. Gross-up clause = no. Do we have PO? PO 47890 matches. Uploaded invoice: https://drive.redwood/telossec/INV-2026-77.pdf
tax-bot: Flag: cross-border withholding risk. Requires tax residency evidence or TRC.
yara (Tax): Quick guidance: For Israeli non-residents receiving services, 10% WHT can apply depending on service nature and residency. We need a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the Israeli tax authority or a local WHT waiver. The scanned 'TRC_pending.pdf' is not sufficient.
ivan (Legal): We decline gross-up and indemnity clauses as a standard policy. If vendor insists, route to procurement for commercial approval. Ask them to remove the clause and provide clean TRC or reissue invoice with net amount acknowledging company will bear WHT.
yara (Tax): Action for lena: request from vendor (A) a valid TRC certifying Israeli tax residency or (B) confirmation they are an Israeli resident charging gross amounts and that they accept any WHT (i.e., remove gross-up), or (C) reissue from a non-Israeli parent with appropriate docs. Without TRC, we withhold and remit as required.
lena (Finance): Sent vendor email: "Please remove gross-up clause and provide original TRC or confirm billing entity will accept any applicable Israeli withholding. If you cannot provide TRC, we will apply withholding and remit to authorities." Vendor replied: "We can provide TRC within 3 business days and will reissue invoice without gross-up." :thumbsup: 
mateo (AP): Marking invoice on hold until TRC and reissued PDF arrive. Will release payment after AP verifies TRC and PO match.
yara (Tax): If TRC arrives, send copy to AP and tax team. If they later ask to recover withheld tax, escalate; default is vendor bears WHT risk.
ivan (Legal): Noted. No gross-up acceptance.
lena (Finance): Thanks all, follow-up in 72 hours. :white_check_mark:
